# exp2 test fixtures (slice S0b)

All numbers here are **synthetic**. A deterministic generator wrote them (no random numbers, no clock), so none of
them is a measurement. Nothing in this directory may be cited as data in the paper.

Marker `=` means: expected output of a producer. The producer must reproduce the file (floats: relative 1e-9; the
CI columns also need the same numpy `Generator` stream). If a correct producer differs, the coordinator decides
which side is wrong.

Rules for these files: LF line endings only (`freeze.json.sha256` hashes raw bytes; add
`exp2/tests/fixtures/** -text` to `.gitattributes`), never name a file `*.local`, `*.private`, `*.bin`, `*.pt`, never use
a directory called `data`, `logs`, `results`, `analysis` (all ignored by `.gitignore`; `test_import_hygiene.py` checks).

Session layout (K9), folder name = `condition_id`:

```
<session>/session.json
<session>/telemetry/{power.csv, clocks.csv, meta.json}
<session>/<condition_id>/{manifest.json, requests.jsonl, freq_switch.csv}
```

`session_closed/` and `session_open/` are regenerated byte for byte by `tests/mocks.py`
(`test_fixtures.py::TestRegeneration`). The `=` files were computed by throw-away scripts that follow the rules below.

## Decisions encoded in the fixtures

The brief is silent or ambiguous on these points. The fixtures take the choice in the right column. A producer that
chooses differently is not wrong until the coordinator says so.

| # | Topic | Choice |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Condition id | File-system safe: `solo_bert-5_f1020_r0`, not `solo_bert:5_...` (K15 shows a colon; a colon is not allowed in a Windows directory name) |
| D2 | Cell id | `condition_id` of a co-run is `<cell_id>_f<f>_r<repeat>`; F1 reads `cell_id` off the front (`rsplit("_f", 1)[0]`), the manifest has no field for it |
| D3 | Closed-loop rows | `policy "closed"`, `policy_spec null`, `queue_len_at_arrival 0`, `n_in_service_at_admit` = other tenants, `t_arrival_ns == t_admit_ns`, every request `complete` |
| D4 | tau and windows (F1) | `tau = (t_done - t_admit) / 1e9` of non-warmup rows; solo window `[first t_admit, last t_done]`; co-run window `[max over tenants of first non-warmup t_admit, min over tenants of last t_done]`; a sample counts only if `t_admit >= lo` and `t_done <= hi`; `s = tau / tau_solo_p50`, `tau_solo_p50` pooled over repeats at the same f |
| D5 | Statistics (F1) | p50 and p95 are `stats.p_nearest_rank`; CI is `stats.block_bootstrap_ci(xs, stat=nearest-rank p50, B=1000, seed=0, level=0.95)`; `ess = stats.ess(xs)`, no clamp; series in time order |
| D6 | Columns (F1) | `n` = non-warmup rows of the type, `n_window` = rows inside the window; solo `u` = mean `gpu_load_permille / 1000` of clock rows with `lo <= t <= hi`; `p_board_w = stats.energy_j(window) / window_s`; co-run `energy_j` over the window, `U_A = sum u_i(f)` from `solo.csv` |
| D7 | idle.csv | `pre` row from `session.json idle.pre`; one `resident` row per idle-mode condition over `[t_mono_start + settle_s, t_mono_end]`; `session.json idle.resident` is not used by F1. Rows: `pre` first, then `resident` by f |
| D8 | ckpt, warmup, mem | `ckpt.csv`: nearest-rank median of `(t_ckpt - t_start) / (t_end - t_start)` over non-warmup solo rows pooled over repeats; `head_frac_p50` = median of `(t_end - t_ckpt_target) / (t_end - t_start)`. `warm_energy_j = energy_j(spawn, ready) - p_idle_pre * (ready - spawn)`. `mem.csv resident_mb = ready.mem.torch_reserved_mb`, `act_mb = ready.warmup.act_mb[exit]` |
| D9 | build_types | levels from `solo.csv` (f_levels) and `corun.csv` (corun_levels); `heldout_level_mhz null` (not in the CSVs); no `synthetic` key; tau stats from `solo_samples.csv` (all repeats pooled, `samples` in file order); `ckpt_frac` and `head_frac` from the `f_max` rows of `ckpt.csv`; `u[f]` mean of `solo.csv u`; class by the median rule; provenance sources `ckpt.csv corun.csv mem.csv solo.csv solo_samples.csv`, hashes `contracts.sha256_file` |
| D10 | plan_run1 wall estimate | `2 * idle_window_s + sum(settle_s + duration_s)` |
| D11 | plan_run2 | conditions follow `freeze.conditions[].choices` (in order) then `grid` (a grid point equal to a choice, ignoring its name, is skipped). `F` and `default` are measured 3 times, everything else once. `condition_id = <freeze cid>_<key>_r<rep>`; arm `pinned` for `f_rule static` else `governor` (`gpu_mhz null`); `n_requests`, `n_warmup` = `freeze.sim`; `seed = freeze.sim.seed + 11 + rep`; session block `settle_s 5.0, idle_window_s 30.0, emc 3199.0, n_inputs 32, per_request` (K15 values); families and exits from the workload types; `estimated_wall_s = freeze.runtime_estimate_s` |
| D12 | freeze | `sim` is fixture scale (16 requests); `runtime_estimate_s = n_conditions * (settle_s + n_requests / rate) + 2 * idle_window_s`; `game.worst` and `game.optimum` name a measured `policy_key`; predictions exist for every choice and grid key |
| D13 | F2 `open_conditions.csv` | one row per (condition, type); `n` and rates over non-warmup rows of the type; `p95_R_s` nearest-rank of `(t_done - t_arrival) / 1e9`; `energy_per_req_j = stats.energy_per_request(rows, power)`; `energy_sess_per_req_j` = energy over the manifest window divided by the non-warmup count; `throughput_rps` = non-warmup count / request window; `min_mem_available_mb` over the manifest window; `f_mhz` is the pinned level or `governor` |
| D14 | F2 `open_summary.json` | `per_condition` key `<freeze cid>_<policy_key>`: `energy` mean over repeats, `energy_ci` `stats.mean_ci` (null for one repeat), `complete_rate_min` = min over types of the pooled complete rate, `feasible = complete_rate_min >= 0.95`, `pred` and `ape` (percent) from `freeze.predictions`. `mape.completion` mean percent error of the predicted per-type complete rate, `mape.energy/median/max` over the keys. `regret` over candidates `F` + grid: `best_key` = cheapest feasible, `F` = relative excess of F over it, `grid_spread` = (max - min) / min over feasible candidates. `oracle` per freeze condition = cheapest feasible measured key. `energy_diff[key]` = `stats.welch_diff_ci(F, key)` for keys with at least 2 repeats. `poa_measured` = measured energy of `game.worst` / `game.optimum`. The fixture has one freeze condition |
| D15 | Open-loop rows | FIFO model honouring the k limits; service = `tau_p50(f) * (1 + 0.45 * n_in_service) * (1 + noise)` times a per-request stress factor (`OPEN_STRESS`); one `error` row (`OPEN_ERRORS`); every outcome occurs; `f_mhz` = pinned level or `"governor"` |
| D16 | Pilot gates | ids `inventory, power_mode_id, coresident_min_mem_mb, warm_over_cold_load, gpu_lock_hold, emc_lock_hold, switch_latency_s, ckpt_overhead_frac, yolo_solo_cv, energy_vs_f_h2` (steps 0 to 9); thresholds are placeholders until PIL fixes them |
| D17 | Scope against the brief | Two GPU levels (612, 1020) instead of one so that tau, u, p_idle exist per level; solo conditions per type (a pair needs both solo baselines); `session_open/` holds the whole 10-condition plan instead of one `c01`; condition folders are named by `condition_id` |

## Mocks (tests/mocks.py, serve/fake_adapter.py)

`FakeClock`, `FakeConn.pair(clock=None, latency_ns=0)`, `FakeBoard(fail_on=, readback=)`, `StubSlowdown(c=)`,
`UnitSlowdown`, `StubPower`, `make_types`, `make_simresult`, `StubSim(table)` (+ `from_response_maps`),
`load_golden`, `write_session`, `synthetic_closed_session`, `synthetic_open_session`, `FakeAdapter` (clock `sleep` or
`virtual`). Their behaviour is pinned by `tests/test_fixtures.py` sections A, B and C.
